result:
Decision is **CONTINUE**: round 77 (decision D-29z42) is written and ready for A. No app source was touched; the store tree still has no uncommitted changes and HEAD is `db9cc25`.

**Round 76 result.** C passed it in the real browser (`browserVerified=true`) with no bugs, and the root gate published commit `db9cc25` to both remotes. That makes stage 2b-1 of SRW-16 (clips snap to markers) done, and the backlog records it as passed and published. SRW-16 and FB-10 stay in progress because stages 2b-2 and 2b-3 are still open. The regression round isn't due until 2026-10-24.

**Round 77 task (SRW-16 stage 2b-2).**
- **What changes:** Ctrl+←/→ moves the playhead to the next marker *or* the start/end of a clip on the selected tracks. On Mac, Option+←/→ does the same; the platform is checked when the key is pressed, not during render. This follows Live 12 §6.9 in the saved manual capture.
- **"Selected tracks" (my decision, since Live doesn't define it):** the active track, plus the tracks of selected clips, plus the time selection's track (or every track after Ctrl+Shift+L).
- **Other rules:** if a marker and a clip edge are at the same time, it counts as one stop and selects the marker. Past the last stop, the existing jump to the project end/start and the existing refusal messages stay. The ◀ ▶ buttons stay marker-only (Live 12 §6.4). Alt+arrows on Windows/Linux behave exactly as before.
- **Files A may change:** a new `edge-navigation.ts`; `markers.ts` (one optional parameter); `stepMarker` in `ArrangementMarkerRow.tsx`; only the Ctrl+arrow branch of `StudioWorkspace.tsx`; the status line of doc 066; two new test files and a new doc 067. Everything else is frozen (453 files, hash-checked). The 4 protected purchase/auth files are untouched.
- **Existing tests:** I checked that the frozen marker tests (MU6, MU6b, MU11, MV7) keep their expected results under the new rule, so no existing test needs editing.
- **What C checks:** 15 browser rows at both viewports, including a real-audio check. With the SFX track soloed, one Ctrl+→ must land on the SFX clip start and the sound must begin within 0.3 s. A second half uses the marker-only ▶ button and must stay silent for at least 1 s. A also runs seven mutation tests to prove the new tests catch regressions.
- **Mac path:** Option+arrows can't be tested in Linux Chromium, so it is covered by unit tests with a stubbed platform and a manual Tech Lead check on a real Mac (R77-T). It is not a C browser row, so it can't wrongly mark the round as unverified.

**Recorded as backlog signals, not scheduled:**
- The five gate-76 review suggestions. The doc-066 status-line fix is the only one included in round 77.
- The proposed shared snap-target helper, for the SRW-16 architecture checkpoint.
- Two older behaviours C noticed: Solo/Mute clicks are undo entries, and playing from a marker past the project end gives no message.
- One new low item: the ◀ ▶ buttons still advertise Ctrl+←/→ even though the key now also stops at clip edges.

On the group-move case flagged in round 76 (a far-out marker can make a group skip a nearer clip edge), I kept the current rule and documented it. Whether to change it is a question for the SRW-16 checkpoint.

**Next:** round 78 is stage 2b-3 (time selection and playhead snap to markers), unless planning falls on or after 2026-10-24, in which case the regression round goes first. After that I'll ask root for the architecture checkpoint at the SRW-16 boundary.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. The second review led to four task fixes:
- The time-range row now drags inside a clip, because a drag on an empty lane makes a selection box instead.
- The video test clip now has an edge that isn't the project end.
- The doc-066 status line is given as plain quoted text.
- The audio check now has a proper control.
